findings.title: Imported feed HTML bypasses post sanitization
findings.body: This sets imported posts to `raw_html`, and `Post#cook` returns their raw content without passing it through the normal rendering/sanitization pipeline. RSS item content is controlled by the remote feed, so scripts, event-handler attributes, or other active markup can be stored and executed when anyone views the topic. The imported-source link is also interpolated into that raw HTML without escaping at line 13, allowing a malicious item URL to inject markup as well.

findings.title: RSS items without `content` abort feed polling
findings.body: The job assumes every feed item has a non-nil `content` field and calls `scrub` on it. Standard RSS items commonly provide their body as `description` instead, and items may omit content entirely; either case raises an exception and prevents the remaining items in the feed from being imported. Fall back to the feed's available description/content fields and handle items with no body.
